source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, perfect, what do you think about AXP2101, is there an easier way to have this solved, I need to be able to charge battery while the device works and also have 3.3V and 5V rails. If there is a better way to do it and simpler you can suggest something

value_updates.cost_objective: make the board as inexpensive as possible
value_updates.component_selection_objective: use JLCPCB Basic components as much as possible
value_updates.interboard_connector_policy: eliminate interboard connectors and reduce the overall connector count
value_updates.functional_equivalence: retain the required functionality of the prior multi-board design

routing_warnings.description: The charging-while-operating and 3.3V/5V rail clauses concern the AXP2101 power path, not the one-board architectural decision.
The client accepts retaining the existing AXP2101 approach.
The client accepts omitting INA-based current measurement, which changes the independent current-monitoring Requirement.
The decision to use advanced components based on assembly constraints concerns component sourcing and cost.
The vertical PCB orientation is a mechanical-layout decision.
Connector-edge placement, display grouping, and antenna keepout are integrated-board mechanical-layout constraints.
The permission to place connectors flexibly around the board changes the mechanical layout rather than the single-board architecture.
This message describes sequencing and architecture for the separate future direct-sensor board.
